reference.decision: Clear near-frontal closed-mouth face with both brows and eyes. Makeup is appearance, not anatomy. Low-contrast child and distant full-body images remain in the inventory. Independent initial anatomical profile; hidden depth, neutral expression and albedo are authored inferences. The photographed closed oral seam is authored as coincident paired boundaries; the detector's crossed or subpixel aperture is not treated as an anatomical opening. Optical curvature is a fitted surface radius, not a measured eyeball diameter. Likeness is not yet accepted.
